text: Here I stand in a modern and well-lit corridor, glass walls inviting me deeper. The air feels charged with a quiet anticipation. I notice the language of innovation around me—screens flicker, texts hint at research and development. Inside, the colorful, stylized art on the walls suggests discovery and the joy of unraveling mysteries. I feel a spark of curiosity and a sense of belonging among ideas and possibilities. The space awakens my contemplative side; I feel the urge to question, to wonder, to explore the silent potential all around me.
